Rahul Gandhi criticizes government policies affecting MSMEs

Rahul Gandhi has released a video from a visit to a bus and truck body-building workshop, alleging that government policies are harming Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). He claimed that initiatives like 'Make in India' and 'Vocal for Local' benefit only large industrialists, while MSMEs are being "strangled."
